name: ubuntuhub
description: A minimal controller-first Ubuntu application launcher

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "next dev --webpack --hostname 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 && cross-env UBUNTUHUB_DEV=1 electron ."
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/check-linux-build.cjs && npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb
scripts.dist:linux:deb: node scripts/check-linux-build.cjs && npm run build && electron-builder --linux deb
scripts.dist:linux:release: node scripts/check-linux-build.cjs && node scripts/validate-release.cjs && npm run build && electron-builder --config build/github-release.cjs --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-release.cjs
